browser: Chrome for Testing via Playwright, real unpacked extension, grants prepared through the product by the owner

checks.name: A page opened as the browser starts gets hold-drag within seconds, without a reload
All-sites scope: one registered script covers http and https; the switch shows it on
Hold-drag works on a second origin with no per-site grant and no prompt
Modifier trigger on a real page: Meta-drag selects; a plain Meta-click opens the link as usual
Never on these sites: off at once in the open tab, off after a reload, and back on without a reload
This site, in all-sites scope, is the Never on this site toggle
Capture this page on a never-visited origin needs no prompt with all-sites access
Save tabs as links with all-sites access reads each tab’s own citation tags (Highwire, PRISM, JSON-LD, Dublin Core) into the collection’s pages, without a prompt
Open as a tab group names the group after the collection when tab groups are allowed
Card: Open as a tab group is named after the destination; Bookmark this selection saves a folder
The switch turns all-sites off (offering to remove Chrome’s grant) and on again
